content:
Returns a list of vulnerabilities for the specified scan.
Requires the Basic [16] user role or the WAS.SCAN_WAS.READ  custom role privilege. Additionally,
requires the Can View [16] scan permission. See Roles and Permissions.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string <uuid>
The UUID of the scan for which you want to view vulnerabilities.
QUERY PARAMETERS
integer <int32>
[ 0 .. 200 ]
scan_id
required
limit
Default: 10
The number of records to retrieve. If this parameter is omitted, Tenable Web
App Scanning uses the default value of 10 . The minimum value is 0  and
the maximum value is 200 . If you need to retrieve more than 200 records,
use the offset value to iterate through page responses.
integer <int32>
>= 0
Default: 0
The starting record to retrieve. If this parameter is omitted, Tenable Web
App Scanning uses the default value of 0 .
string
Example: sort=last_seen:desc,ipv4:asc
The field you want to use to sort the results by along with the sort order.
The field is specified first, followed by a colon, and the order is specified
second ( asc  or desc ). For example, name:desc  would sort results by
the name  field in descending order.
If you specify multiple fields, the fields must be separated by commas. For
example, name:desc,created_at:asc  would first sort results by the
name  field in descending order and then by the created_at  field in
ascending order.
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
application/json
required
One of
AppliedFilters-VulnerabilitiesByScan
Multiple Filters
string
The name of the field you want to filter on. You can list available
vulnerability filters for the scan with the GET
/was/v2/scans/{scan_id}/vulnerabilities/filters endpoint.
string
The comparison operator to apply to the filter. You can find available
comparison operators for the filter in the operators  attribute of the
objects returned by the GET /was/v2/scans/{scan_id}/vulnerabilities/filters
endpoint.
string
The value to compare the given field to using the given operator. You can
find valid values for the filter in the control  attribute of the objects
returned by the GET /was/v2/scans/{scan_id}/vulnerabilities/filters
endpoint.
offset
sort
field
operator
value
